title: Constant-sheaf comparison for the ring lift
statement:
Let $(C,J)$ and $(C',J')$ be small sites [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology] in a common universe, and let
$L:\operatorname{Sh}(C,J,\mathrm{Set})\rightleftarrows\operatorname{Sh}(C',J',\mathrm{Set}):V$ be an adjunction
whose left adjoint preserves finite limits. Write $|{-}|$ for underlying sheaves of sets of ring sheaves
[def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Let $\operatorname{rings}:\operatorname{Sh}(C,J,\mathrm{CommRing})\to\operatorname{Sh}(C',J',\mathrm{CommRing})$
be a functor and $e_R:L(|R|)\simeq|\operatorname{rings}(R)|$ isomorphisms, natural in ring-sheaf morphisms $R\to S$, such that each $e_R$
carries $L$ of the addition, multiplication, zero and one of $R$ (composed with the inverse canonical finite-product and
terminal comparisons of $L$) to those of $\operatorname{rings}(R)$. For the constant commutative-ring sheaf functors
$\underline{(-)}_C$ and $\underline{(-)}_{C'}$ defined in [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf], there is a natural
isomorphism
$\operatorname{constants}:\underline{(-)}_C\,;\,\operatorname{rings}\simeq\underline{(-)}_{C'}$ of functors from commutative rings
to ring sheaves on $(C',J')$. For every commutative ring $A$, the underlying map of sheaves of sets of its component is
$e_{\underline A_C}^{-1}$ followed by the canonical comparison $L(\underline A_C)\simeq\underline A_{C'}$ obtained by writing the constant
sheaf of the set $A$ as the coproduct of $A$ copies of the terminal sheaf (the injections being the sheafified constant sections)
and using that $L$ preserves the terminal sheaf and coproducts; the components commute with every ring homomorphism $A\to B$.

split_report.summary: Audited the abstract constant-ring comparison statement against Tags 0H7J and 00YV. No new node was needed: the constant sheaf as the coproduct of copies of the terminal sheaf follows directly from the sheafification universal property, while preservation of that coproduct is the existing left-adjoint-colimits leaf. The proof constructs the set-level comparison, checks ring operations by coprojection restrictions and the assumed operation equations for e_R, and checks naturality in ring maps.
split_report.blueprint: The four steps realize the sk-thm-rationality construction sentence: the left adjoint preserves coproducts of the terminal sheaf and therefore gives the natural constant-sheaf comparison.

tool_uses.why: Step 2 needs the generic theorem that the given left adjoint preserves the indexed coproduct used to express the constant sheaf; no node in sk-thm-rationality states this category-theoretic fact.

Step 1 is right and needs no final object of the site; I reworded it so the constant sheaf is itself the coproduct rather than presupposing one. Step 2 is right (left-adjoint-colimits Mathlib leaf; terminal object from finite limits); I restated kappa by its equations on coprojections and dropped the q_E notation. Step 3 had the fault (C1/C2): it was marked elementary with uses [], but it silently needs (a) the underlying set sheaf of the constant comm-ring sheaf is the constant set sheaf with the same sections and sheafified operations, and (b) set sheafification preserves finite products, so A̲×A̲=(A×A)̲. Both are existing Mathlib leaves, lem-pc-sites-sheafification-underlying-sets and lem-weil-pbc-sheafification-sets-exact; the sibling lem-sfb-geometric-inverse-image-constant-module step 3 cites the same pair. I rewrote step 3 with them, set elementary to false, and re-checked the argument through naturality of kappa for the projections and for +. lean.statement: theorem inverseImageConstantComparison {C D : Type u} [SmallCategory C] [SmallCategory D] (JC : GrothendieckTopology C) (JD : GrothendieckTopology D) [HasWeakSheafify JC CommRingCat.{u}] [HasWeakSheafify JD CommRingCat.{u}] (L : Sheaf JC (Type u) ⥤ Sheaf JD (Type u)) (V : Sheaf JD (Type u) ⥤ Sheaf JC (Type u)) (adj : L ⊣ V) (hL : PreservesFiniteLimits L) (rings : Sheaf JC CommRingCat.{u} ⥤ Sheaf JD CommRingCat.{u}) (e : ∀ R : Sheaf JC CommRingCat.{u}, RingInverseImage L R (rings.obj R)) (enat : ∀ {R S : Sheaf JC CommRingCat.{u}} (φ : R ⟶ S), L.map ((sheafCompose JC (forget CommRingCat)).map φ) ≫ (e S).ringUnderlying.hom = (e R).ringUnderlying.hom ≫ (sheafCompose JD (forget CommRingCat)).map (rings.map φ)) : ∃ (constants : constantSheaf JC CommRingCat.{u} ⋙ rings ≅ constantSheaf JD CommRingCat.{u}) (kappa : (constantSheaf JC CommRingCat.{u} ⋙ sheafForget JC ⋙ L) ≅ constantSheaf JD CommRingCat.{u} ⋙ sheafForget JD), ∀ A : CommRingCat.{u}, (sheafCompose JD (forget CommRingCat)).map ((constants.app A).hom) = (e ((constantSheaf JC CommRingCat.{u}).obj A)).ringUnderlying.inv ≫ (kappa.app A).hom ∧ ∀ (a : A) (T : Sheaf JC (Type u)) (s : T ⟶ (sheafCompose JC (forget CommRingCat)).obj ((constantSheaf JC CommRingCat.{u}).obj A)), (∀ (U : Cᵒᵖ) (x : T.obj.obj U), (@id (((constantSheaf JC CommRingCat.{u}).obj A).obj.obj U) (s.hom.app U x)) = (toSheafify JC ((Functor.const Cᵒᵖ).obj A)).app U a) → ∀ (W : Dᵒᵖ) (y : (L.obj T).obj.obj W), (@id (((constantSheaf JD CommRingCat.{u}).obj A).obj.obj W) ((kappa.hom.app A).hom.app W ((L.map s).hom.app W y))) = (toSheafify JD ((Functor.const Dᵒᵖ).obj A)).app W a

reviewed_lean.note: Read the node, its 3 stmt_deps, Stacks 0H7J/00YV, the module, the report, and the parent InverseImageData and AlgebraicInverseImage. The hypotheses match: the graph-form ring fields are equivalent to the node's product/terminal-comparison form since L preserves finite products; enat, universes and the HasWeakSheafify Prop instances are fine. Fault (H3): the existential kappa was unconstrained, so the component formula was tautological (kappa := e ≪≫ |constants| always works) and the canonical-comparison clause was lost. FIX: added a conjunct pinning kappa (L of any map whose sections are the toSheafify constant section of a is sent to the toSheafify constant section of a); it holds for the coproduct comparison and determines it. The fixed file compiles clean via nt_compile --json (5.6 s). Advisory: RingInverseImage copies the ring fields of SheafOfModules.AlgebraicInverseImage, acceptable as a ring-only helper. Edge cases empty set, zero ring and L = id checked.
